items.title: Starbucks weighs sale of Japan business worth several billion dollars - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com-- Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) has hired advisers including Citigroup (NYSE:C) and Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) to explore a potential sale of its Japan business, which could be valued at several billion dollars, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
